+class _CurlResponse:
+    """Small response wrapper for pycurl requests."""
+
+    def __init__(self, body, cookies):

+    def json(self):
+        return json.loads(self._body)

+
+class Session:
+    """Minimal session wrapper backed by pycurl."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._curl = pycurl.Curl()
+        self._curl.setopt(pycurl.COOKIEFILE, "")
+        self._curl.setopt(pycurl.COOKIEJAR, "")
+
+    def __enter__(self):
+        return self
+
+    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback):
+        self.close()
+        return False
+
+    def close(self):
+        if self._curl is not None:
+            self._curl.close()
+            self._curl = None
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _normalize_headers(headers):
+        if headers is None:
+            return []
+
+        if isinstance(headers, dict):
+            return [f"{key}: {value}" for key, value in headers.items()]
+
+        return list(headers)
+
+    def _request(self, url, method="GET", data=None, headers=None):
+        buffer = io.BytesIO()
+
+        self._curl.setopt(pycurl.URL, url.encode("utf-8"))
+        self._curl.setopt(pycurl.WRITEDATA, buffer)
+        self._curl.setopt(pycurl.HTTPHEADER, self._normalize_headers(headers))
+
+        if method == "POST":
+            self._curl.setopt(pycurl.POST, 1)
+            self._curl.setopt(pycurl.HTTPGET, 0)
+            self._curl.setopt(pycurl.POSTFIELDS, urlencode(data or {}))
+        else:
+            self._curl.setopt(pycurl.POST, 0)
+            self._curl.setopt(pycurl.HTTPGET, 1)
+            self._curl.setopt(pycurl.POSTFIELDS, "")
+
+        self._curl.perform()
+
+        cookies = {}
+        for cookie in self._curl.getinfo(pycurl.INFO_COOKIELIST):
+            fields = cookie.split("\t")
+            if len(fields) >= 7:
+                cookies[fields[5]] = unquote(fields[6])
+
+        return _CurlResponse(buffer.getvalue().decode("utf-8"), cookies)
+
+    def get(self, url, headers=None):
+        return self._request(url, method="GET", headers=headers)
+
+    def post(self, url, data=None, headers=None):
+        return self._request(url, method="POST", data=data, headers=headers)
+
+
+class _RequestsCompat:
+    Session = Session
+
+
+requests = _RequestsCompat()
